Creates the function row, [[file:glossary.org::#term/slot][slot]] rows, and function-slot links for a record type. Each successful write is appended to a journal. The journal supports compensating cleanup if a later write fails; this sequence is not a database transaction.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/crud/entities/record_type.clj::(defn apply-create-record-type-body][src/graphden/crud/entities/record_type.clj:94]]

:CUSTOM_ID: crud/apply-create-rollback
:FILE: src/graphden/crud/entities/record_type.clj
:LINE: 114
:MINS: 1.8

On failure, traverses the creation journal backward and attempts to delete each created row. This is best-effort compensation, not transactional atomicity: cleanup can itself fail, in which case the code logs the need for manual cleanup.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/crud/entities/record_type.clj::(defn apply-create-rollback][src/graphden/crud/entities/record_type.clj:114]]

:MINS: 4.9

Creates a row, checks the resulting function's types, and applies rename-slot updates. Ordinary type errors leave the edit stored and return ~:type-warnings~. [[file:glossary.org::#term/secret][Secret-flow]] violations instead delete the new row and return an error, keeping the security rejection independent of the diagnostics store. See [[file:../../../docs/SECRETS.md][secrets]].

* 20. apply-create-secret-body
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: crud/apply-create-secret-body
:FILE: src/graphden/crud/secrets.clj
:LINE: 197
:MINS: 4.4
:END:

Creates graph rows containing a secret path, then stores the value and metadata in OpenBao. The value never enters the graph rows. A journal supports compensating rollback if a later operation fails. Request parsing and validation are composed in ~app/secrets/fns.edn~; this function performs the coordinated writes. See [[file:../../../docs/SECRETS.md][secrets]].

* 21. run-tests!
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: crud/run-tests!
:FILE: src/graphden/crud/test_runs.clj
:LINE: 194
:MINS: 4.0
:END:

Runs functions from ~tests~ namespaces through the ordinary execution API with empty arguments; a run passes if it does not throw. Status belongs to the current function version, so an edit makes earlier results stale. Each completed test notifies the editor. Tests owned by shipped packages are excluded from the default user test run. See [[file:../../../docs/TESTS.md][tests]].

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/crud/test_runs.clj::(defn run-tests!][src/graphden/crud/test_runs.clj:194]]
